name: sgct
description: This manifest is used when building SGCT standalone from this checkout. The port under support/vcpkg/ports/sgct declares the same runtime dependencies for consumers; support/vcpkg/check-manifest-sync.cmake verifies that the two lists stay in sync. The intentional differences are Catch2 and Tracy, which are only used by the unit tests and SGCT_TRACY_SUPPORT that the port never builds, and the vcpkg-cmake host tools, which the port needs explicitly.

ndi.description: Build SGCT with NDI support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed

scalable.description: Build SGCT with Scalable SDK support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed
